1445-4871-7422-8249.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-4871-7422-8249.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Garrison Excavator triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

4875-5330-6871-6879.notablePrerequisites: You have an artifact creature in hand with the mana to cast it.
4875-5330-6871-6879.description:
Cast any artifact creature by paying its mana cost.
When the artifact creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the artifact creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the creature enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Atog ability, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 3.

8169-8170.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in hand with mana value 4 or less and the mana to cast both of them.
8169-8170.description:
Cast the first creature spell from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Spell Queller.
When Spell Queller enters, its first ability triggers, exiling the first creature spell.
Cast the second creature spell from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Spell Queller.
When Spell Queller enters, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the second creature spell.
Resolve the second trigger, casting the first creature spell from exile without paying its mana cost.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Spell Queller.
When Spell Queller enters, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, exiling the first creature spell.
Resolve the second trigger, casting the second creature spell from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 5.

728-5276-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-5686-6097.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-5686-6097.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Hinterland Sanctifier triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

277-851-6441-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

851-4094-4365-6664-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and The Wandering Minstrel.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

3558-3652-6108-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
3558-3652-6108-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1594-4002-4331-4993.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
1594-4002-4331-4993.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {0}.
Repeat.

4067-6254-7064.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
4067-6254-7064.description:
Activate Professor Zei's first ability by tapping it and discarding a card, causing you to draw two cards due to Vnwxt.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Professor Zei.
Repeat.

549-1978-6410.notablePrerequisites: You have max speed. You control at least three Goblins.
549-1978-6410.description:
Activate Howlsquad Heavy by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Howlsquad Heavy.
Repeat

141-2921-5260.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-2921-5260.description:
Cast Entering by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Entering.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Entering, with the copy targeting Naru Meha
Resolve the Entering copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
141-2921-5260.notes: You can cast Breaking and Entering fused together to also get infinite mill and self-mill.

1062-3487-4444-5674.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-3487-4444-5674.description:
Activate Noose Constrictor by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Noose Constrictor ability.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Aetherstorm Roc triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

1350-1418-3390-3518-6865.description:
Cast Astelli Reclaimer for its warp cost by paying {2}{W}.
When Astelli Reclaimer enters, it triggers twice, returning Lion's Eye Diamond and Lotus Bloom from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Activate Lotus Bloom by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Astelli Raclaimer from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3197-6752-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-6752-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1981-3330-4416-6740.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
You control two untapped Soldiers.
1981-3330-4416-6740.description:
Declare Phyrexian Vindicator as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Catapult Squad by tapping two Soldiers, attempting to deal 2 damage to Phyrexian Vindicator.
The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
When the Soldiers enter the battlefield, Leyline of Vitality triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4826-5226-5531-6621.easyPrerequisites: Other lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{C}.
4826-5226-5531-6621.description:
Activate any number of other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{C}.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing a land except Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 2 until you control no lands except Mirrorpool.
Activate Mirrorpool's third ability by paying {4}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, creating a token copy of Lumra.
Put the Lumra token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Lumra token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat.

575-2292-4674.notablePrerequisites: You have a green card in hand.
575-2292-4674.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Temur Charger.
When Temur Charger dies, Yedora triggers, returning Temur Charger from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Temur Charger's morph ability by revealing a green card from your hand, turning Temur Charger face up.
Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: can be transformed and with indestructible

1939-3490-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
1939-3490-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Lunarch Veteran triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
When the Servo dies, Luminous Phantom triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve the Lunarch Veteran // Luminous Phantom trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1947-5220-5618.description:
Activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
When Reckless Barbarian dies, Mortuary and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling the top two cards of your library, including Reckless Barbarian, with the ability to cast them until your next turn.
Cast Reckless Barbarian from exile by paying {1}{R}.
Repeat.

3821-5900.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{U}.
3821-5900.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{G}{U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
3821-5900.notes: If the lands can produce at least {1}{G}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any number of other creature(s).

2872-5329-5475.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

3197-4304-5612.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying {3}{G}{G}.
When Herd Baloth enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Kudo, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
When the Beast enters the battlefield as a Bear due to Kudo, Ayula triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth.
Repeat from step 3.

2246-3184-4669.notablePrerequisites: Bard Class is at least level two.
2246-3184-4669.description:
Activate Hajar by sacrificing it.
When Hajar dies, Yomiji triggers, returning Hajar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Hajar ability, causing legendary creatures you control to get +1/+0 and indestructible until end of turn.
Cast Hajar by paying {0}.
Repeat.

864-4377-4428.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Thassa triggers, blinking Eternal Witness.
Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
